non_goals: This is a boundary-preserving algebraic encoding of the logical implication, not a native 2LTT kernel or a semantic model of the record.
The abstract fragment and native S1 control are separate; the source does not claim to instantiate the replacement record with Cubical Type.
It does not prove basic HoTT or basic 2LTT inconsistent, nor establish a natural consumer or same-task reality bridge.
The result is a machine-checked reconstruction of a published theorem, not a previously unknown HoTT bug or originality claim.
